name: Vynthra
description: Hero that can slow and damage enemy units, burrow to biomass, and consume self or allies to heal and gain movespeed.

abilities.name: Deadly Vines
abilities.description:
On impact, creates an area where enemy ground units are slowed by {slow}% and take {Damage} damage per second.
Lasts {Duration} seconds.

abilities.name: Root Passage
abilities.description: Tunnel to a visible location on biomass.

abilities.name: Life Harvest
abilities.description:
Consume {Health} health from a friendly unit.
Vynthra heals, and gains {Speed}% increased movement speed for {Duration} seconds.
On self-cast, affect nearby friendly units instead.
